edits.text: 1. OBJECTIONS AND REQUEST-SPECIFIC RESPONSES. Defendant asserts attorney-client privilege and work-product protection only to the extent applicable to particular responsive materials. For each request, Defendant will state any specific objection and its grounds, identify the scope of production, and state whether responsive materials are being withheld on the basis of that objection. Any limitation of the search or production will be identified in the corresponding response. Nothing in these responses limits Plaintiff’s right to challenge an objection.
edits.name: Specific objections and withholding disclosures

edits.text: 2. SEARCH AND PRODUCTION. Defendant will conduct a reasonable, proportionate search for responsive documents within its possession, custody, or control. Defendant’s request-specific responses will describe the search scope, including relevant custodians, sources, and date ranges, and identify any material search limitations. Defendant will begin rolling production of responsive, non-privileged documents within 14 days of service of these responses and complete production within 30 days. If an unforeseen issue threatens compliance, Defendant will promptly notify Plaintiff and seek agreement or appropriate court relief; these deadlines will not be extended unilaterally.
edits.name: Search scope and production schedule

edits.text: 3. PRIVILEGE LOG. Within 30 days of service of these responses, Defendant will provide a privilege log for responsive materials withheld on privilege or work-product grounds, in compliance with applicable rules and court orders. The log will provide sufficient information to assess each claim without revealing protected information. Any permitted categorical treatment or exclusion from logging will be identified with its basis.
